import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import seaborn as sns
import numpy as np

# Load the data
df = pd.read_csv('data/coffee_sales.csv')

# Create a figure with subplots for a comprehensive dashboard
fig = plt.figure(figsize=(16, 10))
gs = fig.add_gridspec(3, 3, hspace=0.3, wspace=0.3)

# Color palette
colors = sns.color_palette("husl", 8)

# 1. Sales by Product (top left)
ax1 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 0])
product_sales = df.groupby('product')['total'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True)
product_sales.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax1, color=colors[0])
ax1.set_xlabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax1.set_title('Revenue by Product', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax1.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 2. Sales by Customer Age Group (top middle)
ax2 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 1])
age_order = ['18-24', '25-34', '35-44', '45-54', '55+']
age_sales = df.groupby('customer_age_group')['total'].sum()
age_sales = age_sales.reindex([a for a in age_order if a in age_sales.index])
ax2.bar(age_sales.index, age_sales.values, color=colors[1])
ax2.set_xlabel('Age Group', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax2.set_title('Revenue by Customer Age Group', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax2.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)
plt.setp(ax2.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')

# 3. Payment Method Distribution (top right)
ax3 = fig.add_subplot(gs[0, 2])
payment_counts = df['payment_method'].value_counts()
wedges, texts, autotexts = ax3.pie(payment_counts.values, labels=payment_counts.index, 
                                     autopct='%1.1f%%', startangle=90, colors=colors[2:5])
ax3.set_title('Payment Method Distribution', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
for autotext in autotexts:
    autotext.set_color('white')
    autotext.set_fontweight('bold')

# 4. Takeaway vs Dine-in (middle left)
ax4 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 0])
takeaway_labels = ['Dine-in', 'Takeaway']
takeaway_data = df['is_takeaway'].value_counts().sort_index()
ax4.bar(takeaway_labels, takeaway_data.values, color=[colors[5], colors[6]])
ax4.set_ylabel('Number of Orders', fontsize=10)
ax4.set_title('Takeaway vs Dine-in Orders', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax4.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 5. Sales by Size (middle middle)
ax5 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 1])
size_order = ['Small', 'Medium', 'Large']
size_sales = df.groupby('size')['total'].sum()
size_sales = size_sales.reindex([s for s in size_order if s in size_sales.index])
ax5.bar(size_sales.index, size_sales.values, color=colors[7])
ax5.set_xlabel('Size', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_ylabel('Total Sales ($)', fontsize=10)
ax5.set_title('Revenue by Size', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax5.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# 6. Average Transaction Value by Hour (middle right)
ax6 = fig.add_subplot(gs[1, 2])
df['hour'] = pd.to_datetime(df['time'], format='%H:%M').dt.hour
hourly_avg = df.groupby('hour')['total'].mean()
ax6.plot(hourly_avg.index, hourly_avg.values, marker='o', linewidth=2, color=colors[0], markersize=4)
ax6.set_xlabel('Hour of Day', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_ylabel('Avg Transaction ($)', fontsize=10)
ax6.set_title('Average Transaction Value by Hour', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax6.grid(alpha=0.3)
ax6.set_xticks(range(0, 24, 3))

# 7. Top Products by Quantity Sold (bottom left)
ax7 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 0])
product_quantity = df.groupby('product')['quantity'].sum().sort_values(ascending=True).tail(8)
product_quantity.plot(kind='barh', ax=ax7, color=colors[1])
ax7.set_xlabel('Total Quantity Sold', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_ylabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax7.set_title('Top Products by Quantity', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
ax7.grid(axis='x', alpha=0.3)

# 8. Price Distribution by Product Category (bottom middle and right)
ax8 = fig.add_subplot(gs[2, 1:])
top_products = df['product'].value_counts().head(6).index
df_top = df[df['product'].isin(top_products)]
sns.boxplot(data=df_top, x='product', y='price', ax=ax8, palette='Set2')
ax8.set_xlabel('Product', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_ylabel('Price ($)', fontsize=10)
ax8.set_title('Price Distribution by Top Products', fontsize=12, fontweight='bold')
plt.setp(ax8.xaxis.get_majorticklabels(), rotation=45, ha='right')
ax8.grid(axis='y', alpha=0.3)

# Overall title
fig.suptitle('Coffee Shop Sales Analysis Dashboard', fontsize=16, fontweight='bold', y=0.995)

# Save the figure
plt.savefig('output.png', bbox_inches='tight', dpi=150)
